nodes.description: Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom with allowance check, ensure() gate, unchecked balance/allowance updates and _onSaleNum increment.
Internal view gate; whitelists owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale callers, otherwise calls condition().
Internal sale-limits checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that performs delegatecall to an arbitrary caller-supplied address.
Privileged mint that sets balanceOf and canSale for an address; gated by owner or a hardcoded address.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale limits.
Owner-only batch airdrop; multiplies _value by _tos.length and updates balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256.
Constructor mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Private helper performing a low-level call to a token and decoding the optional boolean return.
Standard ERC20 transferFrom using SafeMath for the allowance subtraction.
Internal ERC20 balance transfer with SafeMath add/sub and zero-address checks.
Caller-controlled origin of state-changing calls; used for authorization and as transfer source.
Low-level delegatecall into an arbitrary address supplied by the owner, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked low-level call to an external token contract in callOptionalReturn.
Unchecked balance subtraction in transferFrom; compiler 0.5.x has no built-in overflow protection without SafeMath.
Unchecked balance addition and unbounded _value*_tos.length multiplication causing balance inflation.
Unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
Mapping counting per-address sale occurrences.
Mapping whitelisting addresses allowed to sell via ensure().
Minimum sale amount enforced by condition().
Maximum sale amount enforced by condition().
Number of allowed sales per address.
Whitelisted trading address checked in ensure().

Public allowance mapping.

Public total token supply.

Mint amount parameter of _mints().

Maximum sale token amount parameter of init().

edges.reason: transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared to _from and used as the allowance spender key.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate() authorization require(msg.sender == owner) gates the delegatecall.
_mints() requires msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the full supply to it.
_value flows into the allowance and balance checks of transferFrom.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] and multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath.
_from is the whitelist lookup key in ensure().
_from indexes the balanceOf mapping modified in the unchecked subtraction.
_tos.length multiplies _value in batchSend() with no overflow guard.
ensure() reads the constant UNI router address for whitelisting.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
constructor assigns the owner state variable.
condition() reads _minSale.
condition() reads _maxSale.
condition() reads _saleNum.
balanceOf mapping is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
transfer() invokes transferFrom() internally.
transferFrom() enforces require(ensure(_from,_to,_value)).
ensure() invokes condition() when the caller is not whitelisted.
delegate() reaches the unsafe delegatecall primitive.
callOptionalReturn() reaches the unsafe low-level call primitive.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length before crediting balances.
transferFrom() executes unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom() executes unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
Delegatecall executes attacker-influenced code at address `a` in this contract's storage context, allowing arbitrary state rewriting.
Low-level call to an external token can re-enter the calling contract before its state updates settle.

Payload bytes `b` is the direct calldata argument of the delegatecall operation.
Mint amount parameter consumed by _mints() balance assignment.
Sale count parameter written to _saleNum by init().
Minimum sale parameter written to _minSale by init().
Maximum sale parameter written to _maxSale by init().
Recipient array parameter iterated by batchSend().
Address parameter written to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Local product used as the balance debit amount in batchSend().
Loop counter of the batchSend() credit loop.
Local computed pair address compared in the ensure() whitelist check.
